mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month consecutive rise in federal funds rate above 1.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 1.0% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0% for 3 months, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increase and CPIAUCSL decline indicates disinflationary monetary tightening that reduces real interest rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL falling) produces positive 20-day returns in less than 45% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS above 100k monthly) signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), a declining unemployment rate signals labor market tightening that accelerates corporate hiring and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1,500,000 units (HOUST < 1500.0) signals weakening housing demand that reduces consumer wealth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1,500,000 units, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad housing market contraction that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS and HOUST both declining) produces negative 20-day returns in less than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO above 100) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100.
